options.name: applicationHealth
options.description: ApplicationHealth query parameter. Application health category (POOR, FAIR, or GOOD. Optionally use with siteId only).

options.name: applicationName
options.description: ApplicationName query parameter. The name of the application to get information on.

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId query parameter. Assurance device UUID value (Cannot be submitted together with siteId and clientMac).

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. Ending epoch time in milliseconds of time window.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The max number of application entries in returned data 1, 1000 (optionally used with siteId only).

options.name: macAddress
options.description: MacAddress query parameter. Client device's MAC address (Cannot be submitted together with siteId and deviceId).

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The offset of the first application in the returned data (optionally used with siteId only).

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Assurance site UUID value (Cannot be submitted together with deviceId and clientMac).

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Starting epoch time in milliseconds of time window.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
